card.Text: In the capillary refill test, press the tip of the fingernail or toenail until the skin blanches (turns white). If normal color does not return within {{c1::2 seconds}} of releasing the nail, assume {{c2::circulation is impaired::conclusion}}.
card.Back Extra:
Distinguish: delayed refill in one injured limb points to local circulatory compromise of that extremity, not necessarily hypoperfusion of the body in general.

Cue: the test is typically recommended for use in children, although it can also be used in adults — and before pressing, note and record the skin color, any pallor or cyanosis.
